name: Solomon
summary: The son of David and Bathsheba who ruled Israel after his father. The LORD gave him great wisdom and he built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, but in his old age his wives turned his heart to other gods.

key_moments.title: Made King at Gihon
key_moments.description: When Adonijah tried to take the throne, David had Solomon ride on the king's own mule down to Gihon. Zadok anointed him there, the trumpet sounded, and the people rejoiced over their new king.

key_moments.title: Asking for Wisdom
key_moments.description: At Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream and told him to ask for whatever he wanted. Solomon asked for an understanding heart to judge the people, and the LORD gave him wisdom, along with riches and honor he had not asked for.

key_moments.title: Judges Between Two Mothers
key_moments.description: Two women came to the king, each claiming the same baby. When Solomon called for a sword to divide the child, the real mother begged him to give the baby to the other woman, and he knew she was the mother.

key_moments.title: Brings the Ark into the Temple
key_moments.description: Solomon gathered Israel and had the priests bring the ark into the house he had built for the LORD. When the priests came out, a cloud filled the house, for the glory of the LORD had filled it.

key_moments.title: Turns After Other Gods
key_moments.description: Solomon loved many foreign women, and when he was old they turned his heart after other gods. The LORD was angry and said He would tear the kingdom from his son, all but one tribe.
